column1: #   * derive / delete : the two keys MUST resolve to the SAME value (a divergence is a
#                       silent SSOT bug the de-dup campaign must fix, not hide).
#   * keep-distinct   : the two keys MUST resolve DIFFERENTLY (a "false-friend" alias-shaped
#                       pair that a naive name-based collapse would corrupt -- pinned here so
#                       the AGY-856..930 collapse can never silently merge them).
# Seeded from reference/audit-value-dup-report.md (measured). Grows via mios-dup-report (AGY-856).
# Every name in a row MUST be emitted by the resolver; an unemitted name is a violation that
# names it. (Skipping such rows hid 14 of the 15 [pgvector] keys a lost table header stranded
# under [offline].) A name ending in "_" declares a naming family, not a variable.

column4: # both spell [pgvector].user, the postgres role every pg client logs in as
# family 7 path SSOT under bare + PATHS_ prefix
# family 3 pgvector/db: [pgvector].rls_enable as agent-pipe pg.py and mios-pg-query read it
# OS account mios-pgvector != postgres role mios (report 4.1); the canonical [pgvector].user owns MIOS_PGVECTOR_USER
# family 1 false-friend: 8222=actual host sshd, 2222=reserved canonical operator-SSH port (mios.toml:7906)
# family 7 path SSOT under bare + PATHS_ prefix
# family 7 path: the WSL firstboot sentinel under both names
# the heavy lane image under its [images] key and its lane-named alias
# port alias family: [ports].radosgw under both spellings
# port alias family: service-prefixed spelling of the same port
